data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'K-H-R' which means 'to be strong, powerful'. This name is a symbol of strength and courage, and is often given to girls who are expected to display these qualities. The name Kaharah carries the meaning “Powerful, Strong” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Kaharah usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Kaharah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Strong.”
